name: GPU Isosurface Rendering in VTK/ParaView
aliases: GPU Volume Ray Casting with Isosurfaces
definition: A method to render several isosurfaces directly on the GPU from a Volume representation/mapper without generating a mesh on the CPU or performing specific data transfers when contour values change.
summary: GPU Isosurface Rendering in VTK/ParaView renders multiple isosurfaces directly on the GPU without mesh generation, offering dynamic visualization at the cost of fuzzier surfaces compared to hard mesh-based methods.
